direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge overlapping option-card and evidence labels inside the SVG to 11px minimum and add 6px clear space around JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 so 40 and 30 parts read without crowding.
Add bidirectional highlighting: focusing ev-cert-qty or ev-recv-qty in the inspector outlines the matching 120 or 80 track and node in the SVG.
Give the opening-story logo placement a labelled landmark and keep it at native aspect; confirm no third logo appears in rail, inspector or DecisionBar.

Strengthen separation between ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT for nonce and identity and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, borders, status text and controls so the two tasks cannot be conflated.
Show nonce and identity health as explicit pass, pending or failed rows inside pre-flight, rather than only offline route text.
Enlarge the three option labels at the stage foot to 11px and prevent their text overlapping the evidence markers below them.
Make each Select this path control a 36px radio target with visible focus ring; on selection open the typed consent form and move focus to its first field.
Align finish and incremental cost columns across all three path cards with tabular numerals so 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 scan in one pass.
Label Review recovery option as disabled with reason No acceptance recorded until a path is selected, using text as well as dimming.
Keep 0 BLOCKED prior and 3 PROPOSED - awaiting approval visible without scrolling; state PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL once per group, not on every card.
Refit the inspector list so t3 and End of proposal are visible at 1366x768 or show a clear internal-scroll affordance with a fade and scrollbar.
Fix SVG label overlap where MAT-ALLOY-B - 70 parts crosses 40 via CELL-MILL-1; offset the route label above the neon path.
Make the CELL-MILL-2 preview distinct from a real stop: dashed silver outline plus PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE text, reserving solid red cross-hatch for the applied stopped state.
Place the invalidation consequence directly beside the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar status centre before Apply second shock is used.
Add keyboard focus order from machine selector to stage preview node to primary, with aria-live polite announcing the preview result only.
Preserve red only on stopped CELL-MILL-2; remove red tint from RECEIVING HOLD or render HOLD in silver cross-hatch with HOLD text so red keeps its single meaning.
Separate pre-flight nonce and identity health from the investigation evidence task as in step 2, with independent Run and status controls for the changed-capacity check.
Enlarge the CONSTRAINED - capacity changed label and move it clear of the Split available capacity card so it does not overlap adjacent option text.
Render the constrained Split path as unavailable with pattern, x marker and reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells, and remove it from tab order as a selectable radio.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED - fresh review required in the DecisionBar and beside Human Decision so the state is visible without reading the stage.
On selecting a feasible revised path, open the typed consent form and focus its first field; keep Review revised option disabled with a text reason until then.
Keep both groups simultaneously legible: 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED replacement tasks awaiting approval beside the approved revised plan, each group with its own heading and status.
Refit the inspector so t1, t2 and t3 proposed tasks plus Decline proposal fit at 1366x768, or add a visible internal-scroll indicator; do not clip t2 text.
Add pattern plus Blocked text to prior tasks and dashed outline plus Untracked until approval to proposed tasks so state does not rely on colour alone.
Sequence the inspector as numbered 1 Verify ledger, 2 Seal encrypted packet, 3 Retain independent checkpoint with locked steps showing a text reason until the prior step completes.
Add inline passphrase guidance with character-count feedback for the 16-160 requirement and keep the field error linked by aria-describedby.
Enlarge the stage-foot option labels to 11px and clear the overlap on the CONSTRAINED capacity label carried into this view.

Replace any remaining selected-step styling in the rail with a completion summary: Recovery story complete marked aria-current, all nine steps shown complete, and no primary action competing with the sealed status.

Keep PACKET SEALED - 18 events - revised plan accepted - CELL-MILL-2 offline retained in the DecisionBar and add a single secondary control to inspect retained evidence, with focus ring and 36px target.
Confirm the final view contains no additional logo beyond the header placement and the opening-story placement from step 1.
